rich_text.text: In Georgia, a Russian marriage certificate does not need an apostille.
the spelling of your full name in the notarized translation must be the same as in your registration certificate, passport and bank statements
Once our documents were translated correctly except for a wrong date in one field → we pointed out the mistake and got a corrected translation within 5 minutes.

At the notary you will receive a copy of your document bound (with a red ribbon) to the Georgian translation and the notarization.
Not every notary has a translator, so you simply visit notary offices and ask whether they can translate the certificate into Georgian and notarize it.
